Outcome.Analysis: Identified structural headings based on their function to name, introduce, or divide document units. Titles and section labels (S0001, S0003, S0005, S0029, S0030, S0031) were selected. Numbered agenda items and meeting minutes sections (S0011, S0020, S0021, S0025, S0026, S0027, S0032, S0033, S0034, S0035, S0036, S0037) were selected. Heading extents for lines with mixed formatting (bold prefix followed by body text) were calculated using the format change offsets provided in targetFacts. The extent end offset is exclusive and points directly to the first character of the non-heading text, ensuring no trailing whitespace is included in the heading text. Metadata, page numbers, attendee lists, and continuous body paragraphs were correctly excluded.
